screening_decisions.reason: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled crossover trial evaluating inosiplex (systemic immunomodulator) for alopecia totalis. Meets all criteria.
Randomized placebo-controlled trial of oral prednisolone (systemic corticosteroid) pulse therapy for extensive alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Randomized controlled investigator-blinded trial comparing two topical corticosteroid formulations for mild-to-moderate alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Double-blind placebo-controlled trial of topical minoxidil for extensive patchy alopecia areata, alopecia totalis, and alopecia universalis. Meets all criteria.
Double-blind trial of topical minoxidil for extensive alopecia areata with long-term follow-up. Meets all criteria.
Randomized double-blind trial evaluating topical DPCP alone or with 5% minoxidil for chronic severe alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Randomized trial comparing topical cyclosporine, PUVA, and intravenous thymopentin for alopecia totalis/universalis nonresponders. Meets all criteria.
Trial evaluating topical photodynamic therapy with 5-aminolaevulinic acid for extensive alopecia areata. Appears to be a controlled trial with vehicle comparison. Meets criteria.
Randomized trial of topical cyclosporin A in liposomal vehicle vs vehicle alone for alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Double-blind placebo-controlled trial of imipramine (systemic antidepressant) for alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Randomized trial comparing topical immunotherapy, systemic interferon alpha, and combination for chronic severe alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Double-blind study of topical cyclosporin A vs placebo for alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial of topical clobetasol propionate foam for moderate to severe alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Randomized controlled trial of systemic prednisone taper with or without topical minoxidil for alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Study includes a double-blind placebo-controlled trial of topical minoxidil for extensive alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Controlled trial comparing squaric acid dibutylester, diphencyprone, minoxidil, and placebo for patchy alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Questionnaire study assessing patient perceptions and illness beliefs about alopecia areata. Not an RCT evaluating treatment effectiveness.
Methodological commentary discussing when RCTs may be unnecessary. Not an RCT on alopecia interventions.
Randomized double-blind controlled trial of aromatherapy (essential oils) for alopecia areata. Meets all criteria.
Review article summarizing current knowledge on alopecia areata. Not an RCT evaluating treatment effectiveness.
Retrospective population-based descriptive study on incidence and natural history of AA. Not an RCT evaluating treatment effectiveness.
Observational study identifying prognostic factors in patients treated with DPCP. Not an RCT comparing interventions.
Study with three treatment groups (inosine pranobex, diphencyprone, combination) for alopecia totalis. Appears to be a controlled trial. Meets criteria.
Review article examining genetic basis of alopecia areata. Not an RCT evaluating treatment effectiveness.
Methodological paper discussing study quality assessment for systematic reviews. Not an RCT on alopecia interventions.
